placement: Ryzen 9950X with 24 main and 8 frontend workers

modes_detail.frozen: Exact 943 SDK with fused leaf enabled for 2x2 and seeded 854 for 4x2.
modes_detail.ordinary: Same build. Retain selected 943 leaf route for 2x2 and packed input and output fusion with ordinary Euler center for 4x2.
modes_detail.output: Use the shifted Euler center and fuse the final product with the outer column transform.
modes_detail.both: Also fuse the initial packing with the inverse column transform.

calibration: Same build ordinary within 2% paired median of exact frozen on both inputs.
qualification: Lower paired median and six of eight wins against both controls on both fixtures of the shape.
